title: Trader Diary: 77k BTC & My 10x Leverage
content:
🚀 77,848 → I see green, open 10x, heart rate 180bpm.
📉 Price dips 0.5% → My stop loss is a myth, my coffee is cold.
🤦‍♂️ 1‑minute chart later: “I’m a genius”… until liquidation hits.
lesson: Always set a stop loss BEFORE you fire the order – the market won’t wait for your panic button.
question: Who else’s 10x turned into a 0x today? Drop your war stories 👇
